title: Action Commutes with Silent Configuration Embedding
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\iota:\mathrm{Fin}(m)\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Fin}(k)$, and choose a tape index $\mathrm{cap}$. For any $m$-tape action $a$, any initial configuration $c$, any $k$-tape contents and head positions, and any words $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{out}_0$, applying the embedded action to the embedded configuration gives exactly the embedded configuration obtained by first applying $a$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: natural tape counts and embedding of tape indices
arbitrary tape contents and head positions
